author: Play On Tabletop
description:
We talk about the big changes between Warhammer 10th edition and 11th edition.  Sponsor: Wayland Games, the best place in the EU to get ready for Armageddon and everything 11th edition https://www.waylandgames.co.uk/

JT and Nick read Tak's okay-ish-ly written script on Force Dispositions, Missions, and a plethora of other things. Ben was kind enough to even include bloopers at the end of the video for you!

Thank you for being a Member of the Play On Tabletop YouTube membership! With your support we have an amazing team here that works really hard to create entertaining content we hope you enjoy!
